arcades.notes: Cabs: Big Buck Hunter: Reloaded; DanceDanceRevolution X2; Dark Escape 4D; Dead Heat (2P); Jurassic Park Arcade (2015); Luigi's Mansion Arcade; Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 Arcade Edition; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; NERF: Arcade; Nirin; Sega Rally 3; Space Invaders Frenzy; StepManiaX (65" Deluxe Cabinet); Super Bikes 2 (2P); Terminator Salvation (Unknown Model); Transformers Human Alliance
arcades.info_text: Now known as Olympia Leisure. This arcade has three floors, but all of the video arcade games are located on the bottom floor (apart from Nirin, pretty decent selection of shooting games here, but X2 is terrible. But there is also a StepManiaX DX cabinet on the ground floor. The second floor consists mostly of redemption and pool tables. The third floor has a bowling alley, food, drink and toilets. Do not fall the trap of using the toilets located next door, these cost 40p to use.
